segments.name: AEI technology
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and commercializes ionization AEI technology, including rainfall ionization equipment.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages the business as one reportable and operating segment, which is the business of developing, manufacturing and commercializing ionization AEI technology.

revenueModel.text: Customers are expected to pay under revenue-generating agreements, but the company has not yet earned any revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: As we are currently in an early stage of commercial deployment, certain installation activities may occur prior to the execution of revenue-generating customer agreements.
